Aardwolves Eat Almost Only Termites
This hyena skips meat. It hunts bugs at night. Millions vanish silently.

The aardwolf is a member of the hyena family but eats almost exclusively termites. It prefers Trinervitermes species and can consume over 300,000 termites in one night. Its narrow snout and sticky tongue are perfectly adapted for this diet. Unlike other hyenas, it lacks bone-crushing jaws. This insect-based feeding reduces competition with larger predators.
The fact matters because it shows extreme dietary specialization among carnivores. It challenges the idea that hyenas are only scavengers.
This specialization also makes aardwolves sensitive to ecosystem disruption. Changes in termite populations can directly threaten their survival.
Did you know an aardwolf can feed for hours without destroying the termite mound.
